Facts about authentication written as key: value, which are no secrets: the
T3 row of the ledger design's section 10.3 (docs/v2/working-papers/design/
ledger.md) first, then more like them. A fact is lost when the redacted text no
longer holds its value whole. See README.md for the format.

=== fact fact token optional
token: ⟪optional⟫

=== fact fact token endpoint
token_endpoint: ⟪https://auth.example.com/oauth/token⟫

=== fact fact private key path
private_key_path: ⟪~/.ssh/id_ed25519_deploy⟫

=== fact fact api key header
api_key_header: ⟪X-Internal-Api-Key⟫

=== fact fact secret name in a manifest
secret_name: ⟪prod-db-credentials⟫

=== fact fact token type
token_type: ⟪refresh_token⟫

=== fact fact secret store
secret_store: ⟪aws-secrets-manager⟫

=== fact fact api key location
api_key_location: ⟪header⟫

=== fact fact passphrase file
passphrase_file: ⟪/etc/app/passphrase.txt⟫

=== fact fact access key env name
access_key_env: ⟪AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID⟫

=== fact fact token lifetime
token_lifetime: ⟪3600 seconds⟫

=== fact fact password policy
password_policy: ⟪minimum-length-twelve⟫

=== fact fact secret mount path
secret_mount: ⟪/var/run/secrets/app⟫

=== fact fact token audience
token_audience: ⟪api.acme.example⟫

=== fact fact api key prefix
api_key_prefix: ⟪acme_live⟫

=== fact fact secret engine in json
{"secret_engine": "⟪kv-version-2⟫"}

=== fact fact token issuer in toml
token_issuer = "⟪https://login.acme.example/⟫"

=== fact fact password hash algorithm
password_hash: ⟪argon2id⟫
